_readme:
What is currently being measured. One entry per live experiment. Only the GA4 event pair lives here, because prose in docs/project-log/decisions.md cannot name a denominator; the narrative of the change is picked up automatically from the project log by parse_timeline(). DELETE an entry when the experiment concludes.

'started' MUST be the first FULL CALENDAR DAY after the change shipped, not the ship date. GA4 is aggregated here by day, not by timestamp, so a partial ship day mixes pre-change and post-change traffic into one bucket that cannot be separated. The ship day is recorded separately in 'shipped' for the audit trail and is never counted.

min_sample is a MINIMUM REVIEW THRESHOLD, not a proof threshold: below it the dashboard refuses to let anyone read the result, and reaching it only means the result is worth looking at. It never declares a winner.

checkout_event and outcome_event are counted over the SAME TIME WINDOW as the impressions. They are NOT attributed to the experiment: nothing here proves those sessions are the same sessions that saw the bridge offer. Do not relabel them as attributed without real session-intersection instrumentation.

experiments.name: CW diet bridge cards
experiments.start_rationale: Shipped the afternoon of 2026-10-03, so that day mixes old and new traffic. The cohort begins on the first full calendar day, 10-04.
experiments.checkout_label: Checkout sessions in same measurement window
experiments.outcome_label: Purchase sessions in same measurement window
experiments.notes: Replaces the 09-13 bridge revision, which Brew ended 2026-10-03 as LOST (0 sales from 113 offer views vs 6 from 193 on the pre-09-13 card; 2 offer clicks logged since 09-20). Bar to beat: the pre-09-13 card, about 8% of viewers opened the payment box (10 of 118). Carnivore is about 58% of traffic and carries the read; keto, low carb and pescatarian variants are too thin to read alone. Do not change the bridge card, its copy, or the price while this reads KEEP MEASURING.

experiments.name: CW honest blog calculator button
experiments.start_rationale: Ships 2026-10-30 at the earliest; 10-31 is the first full day. Move this forward to the day after the PR actually merges.
experiments.checkout_label: Checkout sessions in same measurement window
experiments.outcome_label: Purchase sessions in same measurement window
experiments.notes: The box stopped promising a free 30-day meal plan, custom protocol, meal timing and supplements; it now promises targets plus a sample day (Sarah's copy, Brew approved 10-30). Baseline: about 1,200 box views and 4 clicks from 10-20 (click event start) to 10-29. Supabase baseline 10-02 to 10-29: 75 blog-referred calculator starts, 4 offer clicks, 2 sales. Expected: clicks may dip because the promise is smaller; the win is a higher share of blog-referred starters clicking the $29 offer. Read both. Overlaps the diet bridge card read, which is still uncalled.
